endorsements.quote: It is essential, therefore, that AI tools undergo clinical validation, regulatory oversight, and continuous auditing to ensure safety and equity.

unlisted_practices: Institutions should focus on data diversity in AI development.
Institutions should foster collaboration between oncologists, data scientists, and ethicists in AI deployment.
Educational programs should prepare future radiation oncologists to critically appraise and responsibly use AI-powered systems in clinical practice.
Conduct continuous auditing of deployed AI tools to ensure safety and equity.

screen.reason: This is a letter/commentary discussing the potential, ethical concerns, and regulatory/oversight needs of AI-guided radiation dosing and radiogenomics in uveal melanoma treatment without presenting original empirical data.
